D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN N C ; R/ [GLORI] A EXERC ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17, in fine condition; possibly RIC vol. 7 page 223 no. 586, if so, issue of 335-337. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate draped and cuirassed right, seen from front. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN N C. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them, O on vexillum. Reverse inscription: [GLORI] A EXERC ITVS. In exergue: possibly TRP. Diameter: 14.6mm, Weight: 1.30gms, die axis: 6
